testcase.name: CMD001: createAgency yields one DRAFT agency at version 1 with agency.created.v1 and no activation, contract or billing
createAgency refuses a display name that is not a safe label and never echoes the value
every listed edge of the registry Agency machine is performed by exactly one aggregate operation
every unlisted (state, event) pair of the Agency machine is refused as PRECONDITION_FAILED / UNLISTED_TRANSITION with no change
a stale expectedVersion is STALE_VERSION carrying the current safe version and state, before any guard runs
activation guard: legal profile and the required agreement versions must be present; nothing else is activated
restriction and remedy name the documented incident; closure edges carry no extra facts
open, active and closure-authority predicates (D-CMD-2; 07 DRAFT permits setup only; R2-043 closure authority)
every AGENCY_* command role of the catalogue is decidable and nothing else is
OWNER satisfies every agency role; every membership role satisfies READER/MEMBER; unknown roles deny
the seven B06 commands resolve to the intended membership sets
capability sets are least privilege: VIEWER only views, APPROVER does not operate, BILLING does not approve
CMD009 createEndClient: one scoped ACTIVE workspace at version 1 whose identity is separate from its label; labels are never merged
CMD009 guards: role boundary (OWNER/ADMIN/OPERATOR create; APPROVER/VIEWER/BILLING do not), agency open, foreign authority, label
CMD010 archiveEndClient: the listed edge ACTIVE -> ARCHIVED at version + 1, reporting retained work; nothing else changes
CMD011 createProject: OPEN project with its DRAFT revision, capability snapshot and two events; CLEAN needs no target
CMD011 guards: archived client, agency not open, unoffered mode before any quote, target required for CRM modes, role boundary, invented mode
platform machines EndClient (D-AGG-2) and Project (D-AGG-1) obey the registry's unlisted-transition policy
every failure code has an HTTP status, a fixed title and a retryability; the manual codes are all present
describeFailure projects exactly the wire-safe fields: code, status, title, retryable, reason, fields, current, retryAfter
failure messages of the aggregates never carry a request value: labels, purposes and tokens stay out of every message
field vocabulary: labels are 1..200 characters without control characters; reason codes are uppercase tokens
optimistic concurrency (D-VER-1): expectedVersion must match; the next version is exactly + 1; stale carries current and successor
tenant scope: a record of another agency or none is NOT_FOUND; a cross-tenant child link is never followed
registerIdentity derives the UUIDv5 reference, keeps only the subject digest, and syncIdentity follows the authenticator
the launch policy: ACTIVE with verified email and enrolled MFA; DISABLED beats UNVERIFIED
step-up evaluation (D-ASSUR-1): bound to the actor, fresh inside the window, never in the future, never after expiry
step-up is required exactly for the catalogue commands that carry assuranceProofRef
decideCommandAccess: every role's boundary for the seven B06 commands, in the order of design §6.1
decideCommandAccess: identity checks precede membership; step-up denials name the narrowing reason; corporate roles are denied by default
encodeUuidV7 lays out timestamp, version and variant exactly
the generator is monotonic inside one millisecond and never repeats
identityUserId is a deterministic UUIDv5 that differs per provider and subject
CMD001: the founding owner membership is ACTIVE OWNER at version 1 with an acceptance and membership.created.v1
invitation tokens: minted from 32 random bytes, stored only as a digest, compared in constant time
CMD003 inviteMember: INVITED membership at version 1 bound to the intended identity, hashed token envelope, membership.invited.v1
inviteMember guards: grantable subset (D-MEM-1), inviter authority, agency open, self, existing live membership, expiry, invented role
CMD004 acceptInvitation: consumes the token atomically, binds the intended identity and enables only the invited role
acceptInvitation guards: forwarded token (D-MEM-3), revoked, consumed, expired, wrong token, unverified acceptor, foreign envelope
expireInvitation follows the server clock only; an expired invite cannot be revived (07)
revokeInvitation (inviter_revokes): owner or admin of the scope; an admin cannot revoke an OWNER invitation (D-MEM-2)
every listed edge of the registry Membership machine is performed by exactly one aggregate operation
last-owner rule (07; R2-043): the sole active owner cannot be revoked, suspended or demoted unless the closure procedure is the authority
team authority: owner/admin of the scope act on the team, an admin never on an owner, a suspended actor never, foreign targets are not found
reactivation rechecks identity and agency readiness instead of reusing a cached grant (edge effect)
CMD006 revokeMembership: revokes future access with revokedAt and a reason, keeps history, from ACTIVE or SUSPENDED
CMD005 changeMembershipRole: owner-only, versioned, audited; invented roles, no-ops, invited targets and last-owner demotion are refused
CMD007 transferOwnership: versioned pair of role changes plus the agency record; never ownerless, never an unintended owner
membership roles: exactly the registry vocabulary is accepted
listed edges resolve, unlisted edges are PRECONDITION_FAILED/UNLISTED_TRANSITION, terminal states have no exits
every subscription names a registered event type and every event type has an allowlist
payload allowlist refuses labels, unknown keys, nested objects and negative counts
command request digest covers operation, aggregate and body under a domain-separated wrapper
